project_name: Fortune U Group - Premium Financial Services

theme_settings.archetype: Archetype 1: Organic & Earthy (Adapted for Trust/Wealth Management)
theme_settings.rationale: For wealth management, users need absolute trust, clarity, and a sense of growth. We avoid dark-mode 'crypto-bro' aesthetics and instead use a highly polished, light-themed 'Old Money Tech' approach. Pure whites, deep navy for authority, and vibrant green for growth markers.

rules: Never use pure black or grey; always use slate/blue-tinted greys (#0F172A for darkest text).
Use #10B981 (Green) exclusively for positive growth indicators, primary CTAs (like WhatsApp or 'Start Journey'), and calculator success charts.
Primary Blue (#0A2540) is for structural elements: headings, footers, and primary navigation.
Backgrounds should alternate between #FFFFFF and #FAFAFA to create subtle sectioning.
NEVER use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings.
H1 (Hero): text-5xl md:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-tight font-semibold text-[#0A2540].
Overlines/Labels: text-xs tracking-[0.2em] uppercase font-bold text-[#10B981].

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use extreme padding for premium feel. Sections must use py-24 or py-32. Internal card padding must be p-8.

grids.marketing: Mode A 'Tetris Grid' for Services showcase (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8 with asymmetrical spans).
grids.dashboard: Mode B 'Control Room Grid' for Admin Panel and Calculators (tight gap-6, height stretch).

layout_and_spacing.borders_and_radius: Subtle roundness. max rounded-xl for large containers, rounded-md for inputs. 1px solid borders (#E2E8F0) with shadow-sm. No heavy dropshadows.

surfaces_and_materials.header: Crystal Glassmorphism: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-slate-200 shadow-sm.
surfaces_and_materials.cards: Flat background (bg-white), 1px subtle border, hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-300.
surfaces_and_materials.calculators: Neumorphic tactile touch on inputs, mixing soft shadows with sharp inner borders to ground them.

components_strategy.marketing_pages: Use pure HTML + Tailwind CSS. Avoid rigid Shadcn container wrappers to allow overlapping and bento grid asymmetry.
components_strategy.interactive_elements: Heavily customized Shadcn UI. Use Shadcn for Select, Dialog, Tabs, Accordion (for FAQ), Slider (for calculators).
components_strategy.forms: Use Shadcn Form + Input/Textarea. Style inputs with bg-slate-50 border-slate-200 focus:border-[#10B981] focus:ring-[#10B981].
components_strategy.charts: Use Recharts or Shadcn Charts for the SIP/Retirement/Goal calculators. Colors: #10B981 for invested amount/growth, #0A2540 for base.
components_strategy.whatsapp_widget: Floating fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-50 rounded-full shadow-2xl bg-[#25D366] text-white p-4 hover:scale-110 transition-transform.

accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='cta-whatsapp', data-testid='calc-sip-submit', data-testid='nav-services').
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 text contrast. White text on primary blue and green must be strictly checked.
accessibility_and_testing.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Use subtle 0.2s ease transitions for hover states.

media_and_images.rules: Never use placeholder images. Use the provided URLs.

hero_background_or_side.description: Cheerful Indian family outdoors - Use for Home Page Hero to evoke emotional future planning.

services_planning.description: Couple calculating finances - Use for Goal-Based / SIP Planning sections or Tool Headers.

about_professionals.description: Professionals discussing charts - Use for About Us or Wealth Creation service.

blog_education.description: Person reading Financial Times - Use for Financial Awareness Education or Blog hero.

calculators_charts.description: Blue bar graph close up - Use as decorative side image for the Tools/Calculator section.

contact_building.description: Modern blue glass building - Use for Contact Page background or Footer accent.

specific_page_instructions.global: Implement a Language Toggle (EN/TE) in the top nav (data-testid='lang-toggle'). Stick to English copy for MVP, but wire up the state context.
specific_page_instructions.home: Hero must have dual CTAs: 'Start Your Investment Journey' (Primary Blue) and 'WhatsApp Consultation' (Accent Green). Use a clean, non-distracting gradient overlay on the hero image (bg-white/80 to transparent).
specific_page_instructions.services: Display 8 services using an asymmetrical Bento Grid. Icons must be from @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone style).
specific_page_instructions.tools: SIP, Retirement, and Goal calculators. Must be highly interactive using Shadcn Sliders for inputs and Recharts for visualizing the wealth curve.
specific_page_instructions.lead_forms: Incorporate Free Consultation, SIP Planning, and Insurance Guidance forms across the site. Use clear, high-converting layouts (Left: Value Prop text, Right: Clean Shadcn Form).
specific_page_instructions.admin_panel: Strict Dashboard Layout (Control Room grid). Include sidebar navigation for Leads, Blogs, Testimonials, FAQs. Use Shadcn Tables for data display.

instructions_to_main_agent: Read this JSON strictly. Initialize the React app, configure Tailwind with the specified colors and fonts (Outfit & Plus Jakarta Sans via Google Fonts). Build out the marketing pages using pure Tailwind layouts (generous py-24 padding, bento grids). Implement the floating WhatsApp button and language toggle context. Build calculators using Shadcn sliders and Recharts. Finally, create a standard layout for the Admin Dashboard. Do not use any image placeholders; rely entirely on the URLs provided in the media_and_images object. Ensure all data-testid tags are present.
